preprocessing_contract.grid: 240 x 240 x 155 BraTS/SRI24 skull-stripped atlas grid at 1 mm isotropic; no resampling or reorientation
preprocessing_contract.layout: NCDHW in nibabel/MONAI (X, Y, Z) axis order; NIfTI x-fastest buffer reordered to C-order (X, Y, Z) for inference and restored on output
preprocessing_contract.normalization: np.nan_to_num followed by MONAI ScaleIntensityRangePercentiles(lower=0.5, upper=99.5, b_min=0, b_max=1, clip=True)
